tree.text: Any person subject to this chapter who, with an intent to kill or inflict great bodily harm, unlawfully kills a human being in the heat of sudden passion caused by adequate provocation is guilty of voluntary manslaughter and shall be punished as a court-martial may direct.

Any person subject to this chapter who, without an intent to kill or inflict great bodily harm, unlawfully kills a human being— is guilty of involuntary manslaughter and shall be punished as a court-martial may direct.
